links.comparator_used: The same original NHS GIRFT consent forms left unchanged (also compared with de novo AI-generated forms)
links.outcome: Readability (average reading age, grade level, FRE) of surgical consent forms
links.effect: Mean reading age 13.27 ± 0.67 years for AI-simplified vs 16.39 ± 0.85 years for originals (p < 0.001); FRE ≥ 50 achieved by 100% of AI-simplified vs 45.3% of originals; no form reached the recommended RA ≤ 11 years
links.tradeoff: Neither approach achieved the recommended reading age; outputs require objective readability assessment and clinical validation before implementation. Preservation of risk disclosures was not reported.
links.quote: Original GIRFT forms required a mean RA of 16.39 ± 0.85 years. AI-generated forms were harder to read (17.65 ± 0.73 years, p < 0.001), whereas AI-simplified forms were easier (13.27 ± 0.67 years, p < 0.001).

design_hint: AI simplification of existing validated consent forms vs de novo generation (readability constraint)
